sources.title: QB Brendan Sorsby's potential NFL path likely depends on 4 key questions amid NCAA gambling investigation
sources.description: If Sorsby loses his NCAA eligibility, he could try to enter the rarely used NFL supplemental draft. But given his unprecedented situation, this could become a very complicated process.
